items.statement: Base-induced N–H transfer and H2 formation
items.expected: Actual structures and reaction-connectivity evidence support base-induced removal of the N–H hydrogen of 3-nitropyrrole and formation of H2, preserving the β-nitropyrrole identity and balancing atoms/charges. The authors' hydride-contact model TS1 is a reference; chemically equivalent representations are allowed, and source coordinates or a fixed search method are not mandatory. Merely writing a deprotonation label or providing an unvalidated TS earns no credit.

items.statement: The deprotonated nitrogen-containing intermediate connects to the subsequent reaction
items.expected: Valid calculations support the deprotonated nitrogen-containing pyrrole state and its corresponding stabilization, maintaining a mapping of the same anionic skeleton to the precursor for subsequent propargylation. The authors' S2/H2 contact state at approximately −25.5 kcal/mol relative to the initial state is context; the same contact partner/conformation is not mandatory. An actual intermediate state and connectivity relationships must be obtained; two mutually unbalanced models cannot be spliced together.

items.statement: Substitution event involving N–C formation and C–Br cleavage
items.expected: Actual reaction structures, vibrational modes and appropriate connectivity evidence support bond formation between pyrrole N and the propargylic carbon and C–Br cleavage, retaining the terminal alkyne and β-nitro position. The SN2 channel of the authors' TS2 is a reference. Author labels or a full IRC are not mandatory, but merely calculating a nonreactive imaginary frequency or a product with incorrect substitution positions earns no credit.

items.statement: Balanced net product formation has an exergonic trend
items.expected: Compatible energy definitions and complete material/charge accounting yield a calculated substantially exergonic trend for net formation of the N-propargyl product. The authors' G of approximately −45.5 kcal/mol is reference context, with no hidden exact window. Do not omit H2/reagents/Br or derive ΔG directly from the yield.
